title: NoAITell Pricing: Free, Day Pass and Monthly | NoAITell
description: Free: 3 cleanings daily, 500 words each. Pro: $4.99 day pass, $19.90 monthly, $199 yearly.
body:
Free includes 3 local cleanings per day per browser device, up to 500 words each. No login is required. The counter resets at local midnight and is stored in localStorage with only a date and use count. Scanning and reviewing do not consume a cleaning.

Pro Day Pass and Monthly checkout are available now. Yearly ($199) is not for sale yet. Buying Pro records your payment; unlocking higher in-app limits after payment is the next step and is not live yet.

faqs.question: What does the Free plan include?
faqs.answer: Free includes 3 local cleanings per day, up to 500 words each. No login is required.

faqs.question: Can I buy Pro now?
faqs.answer: Yes. Day Pass is $4.99 for 24 hours and Monthly is $19.90 per month. Yearly ($199) is not available yet.

faqs.question: Does payment immediately raise my cleaning limits?
faqs.answer: Payment is recorded after checkout. Raising the in-app free limits automatically after purchase is not live yet.
